data = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/bivariate/bivariate_2021_gas_energy.csv')
adjacency = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv')

# Merge data with adjacency matrix
data = pd.merge(data, adjacency, on='borough')

# Calculate Lee's L statistic
def lee_l_statistic(data):
    # Calculate Moran's I statistic for each pair of neighboring boroughs
    morans_i = []
    for i in data['borough'].unique():
        neighbors = data[data['neighbor'] == i]
        gas_values = neighbors['Gas_value']
        energy_values = neighbors['Energy_value']
        mean_gas = np.mean(gas_values)
        mean_energy = np.mean(energy_values)
        numerator = np.sum((gas_values - mean_gas) * (energy_values - mean_energy))

    return np.mean(morans_i)
